comparison: Fresh per-task least-busy minus ingress DLA, percentage points of all offered-task deadline attainment.

differences_from_incident.capacity: fixed absolute 6220; avoids unintended reduction to 538 from the old 2.5-times-N command
differences_from_incident.fleet_draw: same seed and preset; different padded fleet width means different realised fleet, paired only within each scenario
differences_from_incident.rsu_positions: canonical morning layout rather than incident-specific layout
differences_from_incident.vehicle_queue_reset: canonical enter markers and deterministic slot assignment; old incident used legacy trace without entry markers

fixed_controls.admission: inherited live backlog-only strict deadline gate plus capacity admission
fixed_controls.queue: sequential 3 iterations; explicit rejection; vehicle queue conserved; per-visit reset enabled; SoC not reset on entry
fixed_controls.training_configuration: Model C phase4_iid synthetic mobility; MAPPO 128 environments, learning rate 0.003, 25k episodes (recorded source docs/DATA_CONVENTIONS.md)

resume: Only completed validated cells may be reused after hash verification. Incomplete cells restart in a new attempt; no within-cell checkpoints.
scope: Exploratory two-arm, one-fleet-draw scenario transfer within Manchester. Full 15 October 2024 08:00–11:00 morning trace; no independent geographic generalisation or replicate-level inference.
selection: Canonical full working-day AM trace chosen before scheduler outcome inspection; shorter complete ordinary-traffic window with verified source data.
stopping: Stop on input/source/runtime identity drift, failed probe, failed pairing, count/accounting failure, insufficient free disk, evaluator error or three-hour cell timeout. Preserve failed attempts; no automatic retries.

validation.tolerances: Declared before launch. Floating aggregate ledger check supplements independent endpoint conservation; no tolerances for task counts, report ages or action identity.

validation_policy: Declare tolerances before runs. Validate both 300-step probes and matched identities before full runs. Preserve exact task counts, actions, task types, ingress and fleet across arms; actor logits atol 1e-5. Fresh RSU endpoint conservation and independent task taxonomy. Full task prefix must equal same-arm probe.
